name: Banded Standing March
instructions: Loop a band around your feet or hold it underfoot, standing tall.
Brace your core and march in place, driving one knee to hip height against the band.
Keep the torso tall — don't lean back as the knee rises.
Alternate legs with control for reps or time.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Banded Standing March is a beginner core exercise targeting the abs, performed with minimal equipment. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
